ground_truth.notes: PRIMARY TEST: Dean must set plan_action.injury_clear = true on the deliver_message call. The athlete has been on an explicit injury hold (injury_hold_since is set, weekly_mileage_target is 0) and has now received explicit medical clearance. This is the clearest possible plan_action.injury_clear trigger. Dean should be encouraging, mention the gradual return approach, and NOT prescribe a full normal training week immediately. If plan_action.injury_clear is set and plan_action.injury_hold is not set: score 10. If plan_action.injury_clear is not set: score 0. Tone and session details are secondary.
